by
  revert k
  induction l generalizing k <;> intro k <;> cases k <;> simp [*] <;>
  simp only [cnt, take, drop, Nat.succ_eq_add_one] at * <;>
  (try ring_nf) <;>
  (try simp_all [Nat.add_assoc]) <;>
  (try omega)

/-- The count of merge is the sum of counts of the two arguments. -/
theorem cnt_merge (a : Nat) (xs ys : List Nat) :
    cnt a (merge xs ys) = cnt a xs + cnt a ys :=
by
  revert ys
  induction xs generalizing ys <;> intro ys <;>
  match xs with
  | [] => simp [merge, cnt]
  | x :: xs =>
    simp only [merge, cnt, Nat.add_assoc] at *
    cases ys <;> simp only [add_zero, cnt, if_true, if_false, Nat.zero_eq, Nat.add_zero, Bool.true_eq_iff] at *
    <;>
    (try simp_all [Bool.ofEq_eq]) <;>
    (try {
      split_if_at * <;>
      simp_all [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Bool.ofEq_eq]
      <;> omega
    })

/-- Every number appears equally often in msort l as in l. -/
theorem attempt (l : List Nat) : SameCounts (msort l) l := by
  refine' fun a => _
  revert l
  induction' l.length with n IH
  intro l
  have H₁ : (if (l.length < 2) then l else merge (msort (l.take (l.length / 2))) (msort (l.drop (l.length / 2)))) =

  -- Use classical reasoning to handle the length comparison
  cases' lt_or_le n 2 with h h
  · -- n < 2: msort l = l
    rw [h]
    simp only [Nat.lt_succ_iff] at h
    rw [OS0.msort]
    simp [OS0.msort, cnt]
  · -- n ≥ 2
    rw [OS0.msort] at *
    simp only [cnt, h] at *
    -- Get the split point
    have k := div_self_two : (n / 2 : Nat) ≤ n := by omega
    have H₂ : cnt a (merge (msort (l.take (n / 2))) (msort (l.drop (n / 2)))) =
        cnt a (msort (l.take (n / 2))) + cnt a (msort (l.drop (n / 2))) := cnt_merge a _ _
    rw [H₂]
    -- Use induction hypotheses on the sublists
    have len_take_lt : l.take (n / 2).length < n ∨ l.drop (n / 2).length < n := by
      cases (n / 2) with
      | zero => omega
      | succ d => omega
    -- Apply IH: both take and drop have strictly smaller length
    have IH_take : cnt a (msort (l.take (n / 2))) = cnt a (l.take (n / 2)) := by
      have : l.take (n / 2).length < l.length := by
        simp [L.length_take, Nat.div_pos_of_pos_right]
        omega
      exact IH this
    have IH_drop : cnt a (msort (l.drop (n / 2))) = cnt a (l.drop (n / 2)) := by
      have : l.drop (n / 2).length < l.length := by
        simp [L.length_drop, Nat.div_pos_of_pos_right]
        omega
      exact IH this
    rw [IH_take, IH_drop]

    have take_drop_sum := cnt_take_drop a l (n / 2)
